subject: general
question: Saubhagya Yojana, launched by the Government of India in 2017, is related to providing:

options.text: funds for marriage of Dalit girls
electricity to all households in India

solution:
The correct answer is **electricity to all households in India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saubhagya Yojana** was launched by the Government of India in 2017.
 
• The main objective of the scheme is to provide **electricity connections to all households** in rural and urban areas.
 
• The scheme aims to achieve universal household electrification by ensuring last-mile connectivity and electricity connections to all remaining households.
 
• Under this scheme, free electricity connections are provided to **Below Poverty Line (BPL)** households.
 
• The scheme is also known as the **Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Component
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Funding**
 The scheme is funded by the Government of India with a budget of ₹16,320 crore.
 
 

 **Implementation**
 Implemented by the Rural Electrification Corporation (REC) under the Ministry of Power.
 
 

 **Target**
 To electrify 4 crore households by March 2019.
 
 

 **Features**
 Includes provision of transformers, meters, and wires.
